answer: Each identity binds one registered fishing-quota share. The registry seals share, vessel and key in walnut wood; one share backs one identity, duplicates rejected, weight after one logged season. Per fake: 2,800 units (1,800 lease, 600 vessel share, 400 fees) plus 180 days at sea from the home jetty; 100 fakes cost 280,000 units and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buying a ready quota for 5,000 units, but the seller surrenders the share behind their own identity; a rented quota fails since the season log and the sonar echo of the vessel track must match, and forged papers fail the check.
